ns2:section.sectionText: Introduction to Design Thinking, developed by Siebel Center for Design, will provide guidance to students in learning and building competency in the design thinking process. Students in this course will work in groups to participate in the design thinking process in order to develop innovative outcomes. Have an idea? We can help you refine it through the principles of design thinking. Looking for an idea? We can walk you through the design thinking process to search for opportunity areas and help you identify specific concept directions to further explore. Email designcenter@illinois.edu for more information.
